title: You bought a house. Now what?

scenes.text: You bought a house. Now what?
scenes.label: CHAPTER 1
scenes.voice: You bought a house. Now what?

scenes.text: Congratulations. You just signed your name roughly 140 times, wired more money than you’ve ever seen in one place, and a stranger in a nice blazer handed you a set of keys and a bottle of cheap champagne.
scenes.voice: Congratulations. You just signed your name roughly 140 times, wired more money than you've ever seen in one place, and a stranger in a nice blazer handed you a set of keys and a bottle of cheap champagne.

scenes.text: The realtor’s gone. The lender’s gone. The inspector who walked around for three hours mumbling “that’s not ideal” is gone.
scenes.voice: The realtor's gone. The lender's gone. The inspector who walked around for three hours mumbling, that's not ideal, is gone.

scenes.text: There’s you, a house full of boxes, and a lot of mystery pipes.
scenes.voice: There's you, a house full of boxes, and a lot of mystery pipes.

scenes.label: THE GOOD NEWS
scenes.text: You need to do about a dozen specific things in your first week.

caption.hook: You signed your name 140 times and then everybody left.
caption.feel: No landlord to text. No maintenance guy. Just you and a lot of mystery pipes.
caption.shows: The opening page of Chapter 1, read aloud. The dozen things to do in week one are in the book.
